query:
SELECT 
  CASE m.attendeeId
    WHEN '7258470500' THEN 'Mark Brooker'
    WHEN '174442448959' THEN 'Joanna Hackett'
    WHEN '190937723960' THEN 'Natalie McGuinness'
  END as delegate,
  m.timeSlot,
  CASE m.timeSlot
    WHEN 1 THEN 'Wed 10:15' WHEN 2 THEN 'Wed 10:45' WHEN 3 THEN 'Wed 13:30'
    WHEN 4 THEN 'Wed 14:00' WHEN 5 THEN 'Wed 14:45' WHEN 6 THEN 'Wed 15:15'
    WHEN 7 THEN 'Thu 10:30' WHEN 8 THEN 'Thu 11:00' WHEN 9 THEN 'Thu 13:15'
    WHEN 10 THEN 'Thu 13:45' WHEN 11 THEN 'Thu 14:30' WHEN 12 THEN 'Thu 15:00'
  END as slotTime,
  s.companyName as sponsor
FROM meetings m
JOIN sponsors s ON s.id = m.sponsorId
WHERE m.attendeeId IN ('7258470500', '174442448959', '190937723960')
ORDER BY m.attendeeId, m.timeSlot;
